name: og_evolvable_lineages
description: NEW D (one static-environment condition): selection on an inherited network-composition trait in a population of og_33-dividing protocells, fitness grounded in the real composition->retention->division coupling. GIVEN a granted individual (C refuted endogenous closure). The runner drives this across the full condition, the no-inheritance null (inheritance=False), the shared-feed null (flat retention landscape), and a changed environment (swapped optimum), and reports whether evolvability is real above the nulls and whether it is open-ended or bounded fixed-trait selection.

inheritance.description: Inherit parent composition (True) vs no-inheritance null (False)

retention_lo.description: Retention at c=0 (study-32 short-chain MD endpoint); == retention_hi = shared-feed null

retention_hi.description: Retention at c=1 (study-32 long-chain MD endpoint); swap with lo = changed environment

population.doc: Wright-Fisher selection on an inherited network-composition trait.

emitter.doc:
Store historical states in memory.

``subsample`` records only every Nth composite tick (default 1 =
every tick). Use this for long runs or composites with heavy
state (large fields, many agents) to keep RAM bounded — the
saved time-series still reflects the simulation's true cadence
via each row's ``global_time`` field.

``max_len`` optionally bounds ``history`` to the most recent N
recorded rows (a ring buffer): once the cap is reached each new
record drops the oldest. Default ``None`` = unbounded (the
historical behaviour — consumers such as v2ecoli that read the
full ``history`` are unaffected unless they opt in). ``max_len``
counts *recorded* rows (i.e. post-``subsample``).
